question: Who has been appointed as the Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruchira Kamboj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ruchira Kamboj:-**

 
 
• Ruchira Kamboj is an Indian diplomat and ambassador. She is a member of the 1987 batch of the Indian Foreign Service (IFS).
 
• **She is currently serving as India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations and was appointed in June 2022.**
 
• In this role, she represents India's interests and articulates India's position on various UN policies and decisions.
 
• Ruchira Kamboj has received various awards and honors for her work. These include:
 
 
• **Padma Shri**, the fourth highest civilian award of the Government of India (2023)
 
• **Rashtrapati Padak, **the highest civilian award of the Government of India (2015)
 
• **Distinguished Service Award** of the Indian Foreign Service (2012).
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Asoke Kumar Mukerji:-**

 
 
• **He is a former Indian diplomat and writer, who teaches diplomacy at the Diplo Foundation.**
 
• He was Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations from April 2013 to December 2015.
 
 
 
• **Syed Akbaruddin:-**
 
 
• **He is a retired Indian diplomat from the 1985 batch of the Indian Foreign Service. **
 
• He served as India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations at New York from January 2016 to April 2020.
 
 
 
• Nirupam Sen:-
 
 
• **He was a Bengali Marxist political leader and former Commerce and Industries minister of the Government of West Bengal during 2001 to 2011. **
 
• He was a senior leader of Communist Party of India (Marxist).
 
• He was a member of the politburo of the party between 2008 and 2015. He was elected to the Member of Legislative Assembly thrice in 1987, 2001 and 2006.
